speech: When a flood or a blackout takes down the mobile network, people lose the thing they need most: a warning they can trust.
caption: When a flood or a blackout takes down the mobile network, people lose the thing they need most: a warning they can trust.

speech: This is SafeMesh. A native HarmonyOS app that carries signed emergency alerts from phone to phone, with no internet, and no cell network.
caption: This is SafeMesh: a native HarmonyOS app that carries signed emergency alerts from phone to phone, with no internet and no cell network.

speech: An authorised issuer signs every alert. Each phone checks that signature, before it shows, stores, or forwards anything.
caption: An authorised issuer signs every alert. Each phone checks that signature before it shows, stores or forwards anything.

speech: Phones pass alerts to whoever is in range, hop by hop, and confirm each delivery. Altered or expired copies are rejected.
caption: Phones pass alerts to whoever is in range, hop by hop, and confirm each delivery. Altered or expired copies are rejected.

speech: Here it is, running on three HarmonyOS emulators. A local test link stands in for the radio. A can reach B, B can reach C, but A never reaches C.
caption: Here it is, running on three HarmonyOS emulators. A local test link stands in for the radio: A can reach B, B can reach C, but A never reaches C.

speech: Each phone joins the relay. Nobody presses send. Verified alerts move on automatically.
caption: Each phone joins the relay. Nobody presses send: verified alerts move on automatically.

speech: On phone A, a signed-in exercise issuer writes an alert. The private key stays in a separate signing service. The app only gets the signed alert, and verifies it on the device.
caption: On phone A, a signed-in exercise issuer writes an alert. The private key stays in a separate signing service; the app only gets the signed alert and verifies it on the device.

speech: Phone B checks the signature, saves the alert, acknowledges it, and shows a banner. C is out of range, so it has nothing yet.
caption: Phone B checks the signature, saves the alert, acknowledges it and shows a banner. C is out of range, so it has nothing yet.

speech: Now A leaves, and B comes into range of C.
caption: Now A leaves, and B comes into range of C.

speech: C receives the alert from B, at hop two. A and C never met. That's store and forward.
caption: C receives the alert from B at hop 2. A and C never met. That's store-and-forward.

speech: Next, someone injects a forged copy, with changed text. C rejects it. No acknowledgement. Not stored. Not forwarded.
caption: Next, someone injects a forged copy with changed text. C rejects it: no acknowledgement, not stored, not forwarded.

speech: The map works offline too. Forty State Fire Service protective points in central Krakow ship inside the app, and search works even without Polish characters.
caption: The map works offline too: 40 State Fire Service protective points in central Kraków ship inside the app, and search works even without Polish characters.

speech: For real phones, SafeMesh includes a NearLink adapter, for HarmonyOS's own short-range radio. The emulator has no radio, and the app says so.
caption: For real phones, SafeMesh includes a NearLink adapter for HarmonyOS's own short-range radio. The emulator has no radio, and the app says so.

speech: SafeMesh is built on the platform itself. NearLink, the Crypto Architecture Kit, location, storage, accessibility, and localization.
caption: SafeMesh is built on the platform itself: NearLink, the Crypto Architecture Kit, location, storage, accessibility and localization.

speech: And the same code builds an OpenHarmony product, for the open-source Oniro emulator.
caption: And the same code builds an OpenHarmony product for the open-source Oniro emulator.

speech: It speaks Polish and English, follows dark mode and large text, and announces new alerts to screen readers.
caption: It speaks Polish and English, follows dark mode and large text, and announces new alerts to screen readers.

speech: Every claim is backed by evidence. One hundred and seventy-seven automated tests, zero compiler and linter issues, recorded native runs, and a build that anyone can reproduce.
caption: Every claim is backed by evidence: 177 automated tests, zero compiler and linter issues, recorded native runs, and a build anyone can reproduce.

speech: The radio between emulators is simulated, and clearly labelled. Next comes NearLink on real phones, and relaying in the background.
caption: The radio between emulators is simulated, and clearly labelled. Next: NearLink on real phones, and relaying in the background.

speech: SafeMesh. The network can fail. The warning still arrives.
caption: SafeMesh. The network can fail. The warning still arrives.
